text: What #790's two independent reviews found past its plan, fixed by hand in #799 before it merged. A proposal is read from the comment that carries it or from a saved record, and either's bytes can say anything: a saved record's with every fingerprint recomputed to match. The first review's probe wrote a model file five directories up and removed the file planted there. The second's had a plan's ratification write a file beside the checkout, and an amendment's manifest send the build's code and conformance driver outside the agent's workspace. So any proposal about to be ratified is held to where it may write before anything is written: a clean directory inside the repository, outside .git, .github, .invariant and decisions in any spelling, with no backslash, control character or name that starts with a dash; a CamelCase module name; a short lowercase package name for a new project; a slug that git takes at the end of a branch's name, kebab case for a new project; for an amendment, a .tla module path inside its project and a manifest that is its project's on the base branch, or it is answered as a stale amendment is; and for a plan that isn't a configured repository's, its lock's own check before its files are written, where it was made after. A saved record that isn't fit leaves its ratification pending, as any invalid record does. A proposal carried in its comment is refused in a note on the issue, once, where it was an error in the watcher's log at every poll. A comment of the factory's own, known by its App's login, must end with a marker that reads: one cut or changed anywhere stops its issue, as a broken reference does, and a person restores it, or deletes or empties it to fall back on purpose. With no App a marker that doesn't read stays no post. A marker is read from the end of its comment, so a plan's post that shows one in an acceptance test's source reads as itself. A revision that comes back with a draft and a problem carries that draft, which the build had changed without a test asking, and when the draft is too large for its post, the post keeps the saved proposal before it, with its record. A modeled build that has finished asks three more times, over seventeen seconds, when it can't read its issue's posts, where one failed lookup left a finished run to be reported as stopped and built again. A saved receipt's pins are read with the modules beside its model, as the gate reads them since #829. Left as the plan has it: each use of a saved record reads and checks it again (#892), and the dashboard shows an issue the factory has stopped on as waiting on the post before (#896).
